botcomponent.description: XE currency converter (xe.com). Use ONLY to look up the latest (spot) mid-market exchange rate between two currencies, e.g. EUR to GBP or USD to EUR, when converting sales figures to the reporting currency. Always capture the currency pair direction, the rate and the as-of date/time shown by XE. Not a source of sales data.
botcomponent.name: https://www.xe.com/currencyconverter/
